verses.1: And the sons of Aaron took some incense. Their father, Aaron, also brought some incense with him. They offered it as an offering to God. But they lit a strange kind of fire instead of the usual incense that God commanded them to use.
verses.2: And fire came out from before the LORD, and it consumed them. They died before the LORD.
verses.3: And Moses said to Aaron, “He who speaks God’s words, saying, ‘I will sanctify you,’ and before all the people, he shall be honored. And Aaron was anointed.”
verses.4: And Moses called out to Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel. He also called out to Aaron’s brothers. He said to them, “Come here. Bring your brothers from before the holy place to the outside of the camp.”
verses.5: And they came forward, carrying their instruments with them, towards the outside of the camp, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.6: And Moses said to Aaron, Eleazar, and Itamar, “Be careful not to let them be harmed. Do not let them die or suffer any harm. And on all this matter, all the houses of Israel shall offer sacrifices as an offering for the burning that Jehovah has prescribed.”
verses.7: And from the entrance of the tent of meeting, do not go out, lest you die. For the blood of Yahweh is on you; so do as Moses commanded.
verses.8: And Jehovah spoke to Aaron, saying:
verses.9: May you and your children not be deceived by those who come to the Temple of God. Do not break the eternal laws that govern your lives.
verses.10: And distinguish between the holy and the unholy, between the pure and the impure, and between the beautiful and the ugly.
verses.11: And Moses commanded the children of Israel to observe all the laws that Jehovah had spoken to them.
verses.12: Moses spoke to Aaron, Elazar, and Eleazar. Their remaining sons took the offering that was left from the sacrifices of the Lord. They ate it while standing by the altar, for it was a sacred offering.
verses.13: And you shall eat it in a holy place, as it is written in your laws and in the laws of your ancestors. It is from the blood of the LORD; therefore, I have commanded it to be done so.
verses.14: And the blood of the sacrifice and the meat of the offering shall you eat in a holy place. You and your sons and daughters shall do so, according to your laws and the laws of your descendants. These laws were given by the priests of Israel.
verses.15: The smoke of the burning will rise up, and it will be seen that the milk has been poured out. It will bring glory before the LORD. It will become a blessing for you and your children, as God has commanded.
verses.16: And that “lame animal” was taken from Moses. Then it was burned, and Moses became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who had disobeyed his commands.
verses.17: Why do you not eat the sin offering in the holy place? For it is holy and should be kept sacred. It was given to you so that you could bear the guilt of the sin before Jehovah.
verses.18: Nor did they bring her blood into the Holy Place. They ate it in the Holy Place, as I commanded.
verses.19: And Aaron said to Moses, “Today they have brought their sins and transgressions before the LORD. They have called upon me in this manner, and I have eaten the sin offering of that day, which pleases the LORD.”
verses.20: And Moses heard this, and his heart was glad.
